en: A color postcard showing a staged theatrical performance inside a rustic wooden-set interior. Several actors in traditional Nordic folk costumes are seated or standing across the stage, with fishing nets, wheels, and tools hanging from the ceiling. At the top, large white text reads "KIMITO UNGDOMSFÖRENING rf". At the bottom, a caption in white text reads "TEATERTRADITION SEDAN 1897 (FRITT SVALLAR HAVET)". The overall style suggests a promotional postcard for a local theater association and its long-standing theater tradition.
